messages:
maya: quick help — POC discount stuck in CPQ approval. SF quote shows Special_Terms__c=false but this is a pilot with 50% off. can someone check routing?
jordan: saw it. looks like CPQ mapping dropped discount_tier -> approval_queue. sending screenshot in thread.
maya: thx. it's Acme pilot, 6mo commit, 50% off. should route to dealdesk + finance.
ronnie: on it. can you paste Quote Id? current workflow only triggers when Special_Terms__c = true. we also have a rule: discounts > 40% require manual review.
maya: Quote Q-8891 (https://sales.redwood/quote/Q-8891). CPQ used price_book fallback so the field never toggled. @jordan can we flip Special_Terms__c on this one?
jordan: i can toggle now, but this is recurring. propose an automation: if Discount__c >= 0.4 or Commitment_Months__c >= 6 then auto-set Special_Terms__c = true and create a dealdesk task. draft below:

```
Process (Salesforce Flow) - Quote after save
IF Quote.Discount__c >= 0.4 OR Quote.Commitment_Months__c >= 6
  Update Quote.Special_Terms__c = true
  Create Task assigned to dealdesk queue (tag: pricing-review)
  Post Chatter -> #dealdesk: "quote needs pricing review" with link
```

jordan: also add CPQ price rule to block final approval if Special_Terms__c = false AND Discount__c > 0.4 (with a friendly modal message to AE).
ronnie: that would prevent silent misses. also we should add a quick validation in CPQ: if discount > threshold then require 'Approval_Category__c' (values: standard, delegated, special).
sarah: for process SLAs — agree 24h standard review. expedited 6h for pilot-commitments flagged "release_blocker" or customer_tier=Enterprise.
lee: legal note — any discounts >45% that also change termination or data residency clauses require legal_approval_required = true. i'll need the flag to route to legal queue. i'm OOO Fri so pls CC legal early in those.
ops-bot: ticket created DD-4523: DealDesk review workflow + CPQ validator. assigned to ronnie. https://tickets.redwood/DD-4523
jordan: action plan: 1) implement Flow change (auto-set flag) tomorrow, 2) add CPQ price rule in next CPQ patch, 3) create AE email template + quote modal message. i'll open PR for flow today. any objections?
maya: no objections. can you include a small checklist for AEs? they keep forgetting when it's a pilot.
ronnie: i'll write a 1-pager AE playbook in Confluence and add the modal copy: "Pilot discount checklist: set Customer_Tier, Commit months, attach SOW, select Approval_Category."
sarah: :thumbsup: please cc finance (finance-ops) on escalations > 40% or commits >=12 months.
jordan: assigning SLA fields in the ticket: review_sla_hours=24, escalation_hours=6 for expedited. will publish in DealDesk runbook.
maya: thanks — i'll manually flip Special_Terms__c for Q-8891 to unblock the approval for now.
ronnie: got it, i'll pick up DD-4523 and follow up with the flow PR review.
maya: appreciate it, team.
